condition: Before sole CPU entry, root must bind this exact protocol in CPU admission and perform complete bounded readonly output inventory on either actual exit or owned termination.
before_entry: out absent; all eight PREFLIGHT absences fresh before admission.
actual_job: Exactly one root exec_command. Collect the actual returned owned handle to actual exit or owned termination; never infer exit from elapsed time or guess PIDs; no rerun.

inventory.observer: Root owned independent readonly collector after actual job result, even if import/parser failure or no structured result
inventory.directory: leaf/out; lstat directory first; do not follow symlinks; max8 immediate entries; no recursion
inventory.record: Record out presence/type plus all immediate names/types/byte sizes up to max8; if more, record exact entry count and first8 names and close as capacity mismatch, never claim complete enumeration. Hash all complete regular expected in-cap files; no content read for unknown, symlink, nonregular or over-cap files. Record limitations explicitly.
inventory.receipt: leaf/OUTPUT-INVENTORY.json outside out, with actual tool result association, observer PID/UTC, names/types/bytes/hashes and limits. Preserve partial and unknown files untouched.

close_exact_method_if: actual job nonzero or unknown status
missing out or any required file
unexpected file, symlink, nonregular, per-file or aggregate cap mismatch
any other first complete data B or unknown
close_behavior: Preserve all files and actual status; no retry, source repair, model parse/adoption, GPU entry, retake or successor. Static source A does not qualify actual files or appearance.
witness: Frozen build.mjs220-229 exclusive output writes and final BUILD-RESULT wrapper may leave a prefix or fail final result write; no actual failure or lost file is asserted.

alternatives.tradeoff: No frozen source changes; root owns complete independent file/status evidence and preserves partials.
